relations.evidence: The primary components of the Auth Service include: - **Token Issuer**: Responsible for creating and signing access and refresh tokens used for user authentication.
The primary components of the Auth Service include: - **Session Store (Redis)**: Used to manage user sessions and store state information.
The primary components of the Auth Service include: - **MFA Verifier**: Facilitates multi-factor authentication to enhance security during the login process.
The primary components of the Auth Service include: - **OIDC Provider**: Implements OpenID Connect to support authentication and information exchange protocols.
